rows.notes: [T099] start_year 2025: pv magazine India 2025-07-14 (S1) says Ola 'began in-house production of its advanced 4680-format Bharat Cell this year' (2025); the same sentence gives current capacity 1.4 GWh (July 2025, company/press basis) -> step 2025 = 1.4 added, existing 2026 = 6 step kept. Other press (not cited) shows trial production in Aug 2024 and S1 Pro+ deliveries with the cell from ~Dec 2025; the first commercial in-house cell production year is taken as 2025 per S1. The quote was returned by the fetch tool's summary of the page: auditor should string-match.

[T099] start_year 2019: Jiemian 2023-12-18 (S2): phase-1 3 GWh line did batch trial production in Oct 2018 and 'achieved batch delivery of lithium-ion batteries in April 2019'. I take first commercial production = first batch delivery = 2019 (trial production Oct 2018 is not counted; if the lead counts trial runs, 2018 applies). Step 2019 = 3 is the phase-1 line capacity named in the same sentence (design/line basis, not an audited installed figure). Phase 2 (8 GWh, planned H2 2021) and phase 3 production years not found; no later steps. Quote returned by fetch tool summary: auditor should string-match.

[T099] start_year 2025, LOW-MEDIUM confidence: Huxiu (S3, page timestamp 2026-09-13) states the Xiaogan base phase 1 'has been put into production on 28 June 2025' with design capacity 35 GWh/yr (matches the existing 2025 = 35 step). The same article calls Xiaogan the earliest-built base and HQ, and gives Wuhan phase 1 as the company's first production (Nov 2022, 10 GWh), so an earlier pilot line at Xiaogan cannot be excluded; no source found for one. Secondary media source (not company); quote returned by fetch tool summary: auditor should string-match.

[T099] start_year 2021: The Nation Thailand 2021-12-13 (S4), headline 'EA announces the success of grand opening of the first Gigafactory', refers to 'the commercial launch of Amita Technology (Thailand)' and gives initial capacity 1 GWh/yr (same page: 'has an initial capacity of 1 GWh per year.'), matching the existing 2021 = 1 step. Weakness: the article is about the opening ceremony; it does not say cells were first sold in Dec 2021, and it does not name Chachoengsao (only the EEC). Search summaries (Bangkok Post, not fetched) say the plant passed a trial run after a COVID delay before the 12 Dec 2021 opening. Quote returned by fetch tool summary: auditor should string-match.

[T099] start_year 2023 and step 2023 = 5: SMM 2023-08-22 (S5) reports that on 19 August (2023) Jiangsu Yuanhang Jinli held a ceremony for the first phase of energy storage cell commissioning (投产); the CNY 3 bn project 'has been fully commissioned and has a total capacity of 5GWh' (press basis, project capacity at commissioning). The same report says a CNY 5 bn phase 2 was signed that day (no production date; no later step). Only the English SMM text was read; the original Chinese wording was not seen. Quote returned by fetch tool summary: auditor should string-match.

[T099] start_year 2020 and step 2020 = 5: MarkLines 2020-09-29 (S6) reports the Nantong new plant held its commissioning (投产) ceremony and 'the phase 1 project now in production has an annual capacity of 5GWh, investment CNY 1.5 bn' (press basis).
